# Matt Graham Books

> Official website of Matt Graham, a retired California judge who writes legal thrillers. He is the author of The Van Nuys Courthouse Legal Thriller Series: Hidden Behind the Robe (2022) and Special Directives (2026). Not to be confused with other people named Matt Graham.

## Key facts
- Former state prosecutor (ten years), Los Angeles County Superior Court judge (about 200 felony trials), and California Court of Appeal justice (more than 1,000 decisions).
- His novels are courtroom thrillers told from the judge's side of the bench, set in the Van Nuys courthouse in Los Angeles.
- Hidden Behind the Robe was a 2022 Reader's Favorite award winner in the legal thriller category.
- Special Directives (March 2026) follows a Los Angeles courthouse's response to a progressive District Attorney's policies on juvenile felons.
